description: Department of Trade & Investment Policy - Special Commodity Levy on Fish, Green-gram, Mangoesteens ect, w.e.f. 08.05.2017 for Six month period
categorisation: This gazette content imposes a Special Commodity Levy on various goods under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It establishes regulatory requirements and compliance measures for specific commodities, making it primarily about legal/regulatory framework rather than government personnel, organizational structure, or any other specialized category. While it mentions the Minister of Finance by name, this is incidental to the main purpose of publishing regulatory changes, and no detailed portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes are described.
